header: What the 2025 report says, in five lines
lead: The full report has 60 pages. If you read nothing else, read these.

points.title: Summer was 1.4 degrees warmer than average.
points.text: Compared with the 12-year average, across all 46 stations and not only the shallow ones.

points.title: 11 days above 21 degrees at three stations.
points.text: The previous record was four days, in 2018.

points.title: Oxygen lows moved from August to late July.
Open gravel depth fell by another 8 cm.
points.text: Sampled by hand at 12 points below the weir, so the error band is wider than for the sensor data.

points.title: Summer sampling every two weeks from May 2026.
